Restaurant reservations: daily challenge, 2027-02-05

The shared System Designer challenge for 2027-02-05: Restaurant reservations. Build a design and test the same seeded traffic day as everyone else. Free, no sign-up.

Open the challenge

Diners look up restaurants, check which tables are free tonight and book one. Looking is easy to speed up. Booking is not: two people must never get the same table. Friday at 5 pm is the busy moment.

The daily scenario changes the event schedule and pressure. Read the base problem for its requirements and concepts, then open this date’s challenge to see the daily variant.
